label: D2 arrival in S2 after an unrewarded trial (not from S2), when the policy is undecided
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (97% of mass), never at GO, and only when S2 is reached (in_state==2 holds 97% of mass; it never fires on S1). It also needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward==0, 97% of mass). Those three conditions alone give recall 0.93 / mass 0.97 but precision only 0.14. Precision goes up when the previous trial did not also reach S2 (prev_state==1 or outside the window) and when the policy logit difference at that step is near zero (choice in [-1.5, 2.8], i.e. the agent is undecided about what to do next): dev P 0.60 R 0.72 F1 0.65 mass 0.88. All variables are observed (choice is the model output). It is more likely to fire on switch trials (stay==0, 6.6x lift) and early in the episode (episode trial 0: 24x), and its rate falls steadily over the episode. Weak D1 firings (3% of mass) mostly come right after an S2-rare trial. The near-zero choice condition is an internal correlate, not an input. Without it the best F1 is about 0.35.
